# Horsehead Corporation

Horsehead Corporation is a prominent American chemical and metals company headquartered at 300 Frankfort Road, Monaca, Pennsylvania 15061-2295. With a rich history in the zinc and specialty chemicals industry, the company has established itself as one of the leading producers of zinc and zinc-based products in North America.

The corporation has long been recognized for its expertise in zinc recovery and processing, serving a wide range of industries including steel manufacturing, chemical production, agriculture, and construction. Horsehead Corporation has built its reputation on innovative processes for reclaiming zinc from electric arc furnace (EAF) dust, a byproduct of steel production, thereby contributing significantly to environmental sustainability through recycling efforts.

Over the years, the company has developed and refined proprietary technologies that allow for the efficient extraction and processing of zinc and other valuable metals from industrial waste streams. This commitment to environmental stewardship, combined with its operational excellence, has positioned Horsehead Corporation as a key player in the circular economy within the metals and chemicals sector.

The company's product portfolio includes zinc metal, zinc oxide, zinc dust, and various zinc-based chemicals that serve critical applications across multiple industries. Their products are essential components in galvanizing processes, rubber manufacturing, ceramics, pharmaceuticals, and agricultural applications, among others. Horsehead Corporation continues to be a vital contributor to the American chemical and metals industry, maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and environmental responsibility in all its operations.
